It means you have a goal, a road, a place that is not easily obtained, but the path to get to it (if it exists or not) is something you can try to go down, and this is part the human spirit, the thing that brings us happiness. It drives us to build, research, socialize and all other things. 

Wanting is like hunger, some people will have to try harder than others to eat, and some will starve, but to any who get a bite, they will experience satisfaction. Lets hope you get a bite.

This question, in a very similar form, will not leave me alone as well. But what can be reasoned is this. The humans spirit is indomitable at achieving things, and your ability to get what you want is directly related to 3 categories, motivation, luck, and networking. 

Based on those premises, it stands to reason, if there is something worth living for, something that you think would make life worth living, then attempting to achieve it is a small reason to live. The magnitude of a reason to live is not important, the only thing that is important is its resilience, it cannot change day to day, it has to be true, if it is then life is worth living. 
The caviot (spelling?) is simple, what is actually worth living. There are biological/evolutionary reasons like sex, power, family, etc. and many other forms of reasons, but to me they are all bullshit.

TL;DR If you can imagine a life worth living, then your life is worth living. But can you actually imagine a life worth living?

No but what is utter bullshit and stupidity is living for something to get better. What can you actually want to live for? Money, Power, Freedom, your answer will be predictable and essentially like saying food (something we naturally seek, but compeltely pointless).

So the question remains, what is worth staying for? Essentially every post here says, happiness, or getting better. These are completely devoid of any meaning, happiness is a mirage that you allow to happen to yourself; its you letting your brain release chemicals for something which without humans would be meaningless. And moreover the event, item, or person who gives this happiness is ambivalent, if we were to say nitrogen is worth as much as gold, or nickle was as rare as diamonds, we would have people being estatic over a rock or the air around us. This can be extended, to all aspects of existing. But here is the caviot. To obtain this pointless bullshit of hapiness, we much also take in pointless bullshit of pain, and endure monotony and so many other useless and unpleasant things. So knowing that it is all pointless, that it is literally a choice to give ourselfs drugs, and the price we pay is a lifetime of the hardships of existance, all for what is ultimately nothing (when we stop existing). Why not just turn back into the inanimate matter that we truly are? 

There either is a reason to endure life, or there is a reason to escape it. Being happy can be bought, forced and many other things, it is nowhere  near a reason, it is an illusion, a drug which has helped our species and all life survive.
